w: Swamishri addressed an assembly of fishermen.

During a special assembly for fishermen, Swamishri blessed them, saying, "... This worldly life is like a jungle or a huge ocean. If you want to cross this ocean, the most you can endeavor is two or three miles. You need a ship to cross it.

"If you get lost in a jungle, you need a guide to get you out. Similarly, we are living in this jungle or ocean of life and we need the holy sadhu as a guide. Just as you are familiar with the ocean and know where the dangers lie, likewise, the holy sadhu is the true guide of life. He steers you away from the dangers and inspires you with pure, good and morally fragrant living.

Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha ceremony of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev and Guru Parampara in the one pinnacled BAPS Hari mandir. More than 12,000 devotees and well-wishers had attended the opening ceremony.

Swamishri was welcomed by tribal devotees on arriving at the village of Nana Pondha, 30 kms from Selvas. Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Guru parampara, Hanumanji and Ganapatiji and inaugurated the Swaminarayan Mandir.

During the pratishtha assembly Swamishri appreciated the efforts of the tribal devotees in constructing the mandir. He added, "...Through the spiritual association of sadhus you have realized the glory of satsang. Your life was such that no matter how much you may have endeavored you may not have been able to raise your level of life. But today you are free from addictions and vices, you have learnt to wear proper clothes, you have better houses to live in and good education. Because of satsang your life has become morally and socially fragrant." This evening at 6.50 p.m., Swamishri celebrated Nrusinh Jayanti by performing arti and extolling the faith of Prahlad and the victory of good over evil.

At 10.15 am Swamishri departed from Amdavad mandir and arrived at the newly inaugurated BAPS Swaminarayan mandir in the suburb of Odhav. Here Swamishri performed pujan and arti rituals of the murtis and blessed the assembly.
At 11.10 am Swamishri departed and reached Vidyanagar at 12.00 noon for the 4-day 13th Sant Shibir. The first shibir concluded on 10 May 2005.

At 10.00 am Swamishri departed from Junagadh. On the way to Gondal Swamishri sanctified the land in Jetpur on which the construction work of the BAPS hari mandir was going on. In the evening assembly in Gondal Prabhucharan Swami elaborated upon the Shrimad Bhagvat as part of the seven-day parayan.

A devotee phoned. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! Forgive me. I did not want to trouble you, but I have to speak to you alone about this. So I am speaking. You are the master, so it has to be told to you alone!"
Swamishri said in the middle, "Not the master. We are servants. The master is God." Saying this, Swamishri listened to what he had to say.

A devotee phoned. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! Please forgive me. I did not want to trouble you, but I have to speak to you alone about this. So I am telling you. You are the master, so it is you whom I must tell, isn't it!"
Swamishri said in the middle, "Not the master. We are only servants. The master is God." Saying this, Swamishri listened to what he had to say.

A phone call came from a devotee. He said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Bapa! Please forgive me. I did not want to trouble you, but I have to speak to you. So I am speaking. You are the master, so it is to you that I must speak, isn't it!"
Swamishri said, interrupting him, "Not the master. We are only servants. God is the master." Having said this, Swamishri listened to what he had to say.

A devotee called and said to Swamishri, "Bapa! Forgive me. I did not want to trouble you, but this is something I must tell only you. So I am telling you. You are the master, so of course I must tell you!"
Swamishri said, cutting in, "Not master. We are only servants. God is the master." Saying this, Swamishri listened to what he had to say.

After darshan at the mandir, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came down. After coming down from the lift, Swamishri first places flowers on the items devotees have brought to be sanctified. Today a daf (frame drum) had come. Next to the daf placed on a stand was its stick. Swamishri took the stick and played the daf for a while, giving everyone a special memory. After that he went to his puja.

During the meal, Purushottamcharan Swami gave Pramukh Swami Maharaj information about the water shortage in Gondal, that there was a water shortage in the whole of Gondal and that at present there was great difficulty in the mandir too, and that they were thinking of some arrangements for it. Swamishri immediately said, "Do it not just for us alone but for everyone, then things will be properly looked after."
Swamishri spoke a wonderful, meaningful maxim.

A youth named Rahul Rana of Bareja walked overnight on foot from Bareja and reached here in Ahmedabad in the morning. He barely rested in the morning, and then, according to his turn, did pradakshinas in the 'Abhishek Mandapam' for two hours in the afternoon. Then, the next day, he stayed the night and did about 1,800 pradakshinas through the whole night. Pramukh Swami Maharaj was very pleased to see such devotion of his.

Immediately Swamishri said, "Not just for us alone, do it for everyone, then things will be properly taken care of."
Swamishri spoke a wonderful maxim.

A youth named Rahul Rana of Bareja walked through the night from Bareja and reached Ahmedabad here in the morning. In the morning he barely rested, and in the afternoon, in his turn, did circumambulations for two hours in the "Abhishek Mandapam". Then the next day he stayed overnight and did as many as 1,800 circumambulations through the whole night. Pramukh Swami Maharaj was very pleased to see such devotion.
